english.title: Drive a taxi on to an Authorised Standing on Heathrow Airport without having driven through a Taxi Feeder Park
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), otherwise than under the direction or with the consent of
